name: 32832 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32832 (Orlando) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32832 (Orlando) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32832 (Orlando) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
